name: _cast_Short
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI): aten::_cast_Short(Tensor self, bool non_blocking=False) -> Tensor. This representative signature is not exclusive: original Gems pytest owns the full contract of overloads, keyword arguments, returns, errors, aliasing and mutation, and no test or reference behavior may be removed, narrowed or adapted to fit this one signature. All supplied registered schemas, verbatim: aten::_cast_Short(Tensor self, bool non_blocking=False) -> Tensor. Semantics (from the actual tests): unary elementwise cast of self to int16 (torch.int16); the only extra argument is the bool flag non_blocking, whose schema default is false and which the tests exercise as both True and False. The operator has no out overload, carries no autograd history, and accepts arbitrary rank, empty shapes, non-contiguous/offset/expanded views and a lazy conjugate bit. Conditional overload behavior deliberately kept in pytest and not modeled here: when self is already int16, the native operator returns the very input object (op(x) is x, equal data_ptr) including for views, 0-dim and empty tensors, so the pytest alias test asserts identity as well as values; error behavior (non-Tensor input, invalid non_blocking type, unknown keyword, missing or extra argument) and out-of-range/non-finite handling, which the tests treat as device-dependent rather than following a universal rule, are also owned by the original pytest rather than expressed by this single-signature model.
